notes.title: Update v1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello!
This time, I made the following updates.

[list]
[*]The settings section can now be opened from the pause screen.
[*] Fixed the time scale reverting at the moment of retrying on the pause screen or returning to the title screen. This avoids a bug that occurred when the game was over in that short amount of time.
[/list]

If you have any problems please let me know via the "Report a Bug" button on the title screen.

notes.title: Update v1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello!
This time, I made the following updates.

[list]
[*]Allied characters are now less likely to collide with you while moving.
[*]Addressed an issue where the rate of fire of the Gatling Gun would vary greatly depending on the framerate.
[*]Fixed an issue where the background music would sometimes disappear when a lot of sound effects were playing.
[/list]

If you have any problems, please let us know using the "Report a bug" button.

notes.title: Update v1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello!
This time, I made the following updates.

[list]
[*]I have taken emergency action against a bug that causes the game to become unprogressive on level 15. As far as I've checked it seems to be ok, but please let me know if you still have problems.
[*]Implemented options to invert the viewpoint control. More precisely, you can invert the viewpoint control by setting a negative mouse sensitivity value.
[*]Minor game balance adjustments have been made to Challenge Mode.
[/list]

Please continue to send me any problems or requests via the 'Report bug' button.

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello!
This time, I made the following updates.

[list]
[*]Implemented a pause screen. Hold the Esc key to pause the game.
[*]Fixed a situation in some levels where the game could get stuck due to being able to kill an enemy before combat.
[*]Improved pathfinding.
[/list]

If you have any problems, please send it from the "Report a bug" button.

By the way, there are still bugs that affect the progress of the game. I'm not sure what the cause is, so I'll continue to investigate.

notes.title: Plans for updates
notes.content:
Hello! I am KurokumaSoft, the developer of this game.

First of all, I am very happy that more people than I expected have played this game and written reviews. Thank you all!

Now I'd like to inform you about my plans for updates. Here are some of the things I'm thinking about updating at the moment.
[list]
[*]Improve operability.
[*]Fix bugs.
[*]Add more level variations for Challenge Mode.
[/list]
Incidentally, and this is embarrassing, the project file for this game has a rather messed up structure, and it is difficult to change it from its current state. So I can't make major updates, but I will make small updates little by little.

Finally, if you have any requests, please don't hesitate to send them via the 'Report bug' button on the title screen. Best regards!
